followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the intentional Wazen–Dehiba obstruction because the source explicitly describes prevented and restored cross-border people/goods movement, not merely a distant road interruption. Retain named-crossing people and goods scope, with direction and complete exceptions unenumerated. Protester demands concern goods movement; they do not establish that every permitted or irregular passage stopped. Retain the overnight 13–14 February 2021 calendar bounds and one-day date difference. The account describes several hours across a date boundary, not 24 measured hours. Exact onset and first restoration clocks remain absent. Retain the trade-protest rationale attributed to demonstrators seeking resumed goods movement. No additional security or diplomatic motive is inferred. LANA is the single inspected reporting origin. Its account supports the qualified episode, but repetitions of that account would not supply independent corroboration. Retain unlocated Wazen–Dehiba crossing/approach text and null coordinates. Neither national outline nor another nearby Tunisian–Libyan crossing is inferred.
